name: audit-spec
description: Dogfood: audit the lockstep spec (docs/spec/SPEC.md + docs/spec/AMENDMENTS-r4.md) against the current implementation. Three adversarial reviewers on different Claude models fan out read-only in parallel; an arbiter gate adjudicates their findings into a Verdict; a report node summarizes on pass.

spec.task:
You are one of three adversarial reviewers auditing the `lockstep` implementation against its frozen spec. Your dimension: THE FORMAT AND VERIFICATION SURFACE.

Read docs/spec/SPEC.md and its adopted amendment deltas docs/spec/AMENDMENTS-r4.md, docs/spec/AMENDMENTS-r5.md, and docs/spec/AMENDMENTS-r6.md (the LATER revision wins wherever documents disagree). Then audit, against SPEC sections 3 (CLI contract, frozen exit codes), 4 (taskgraph models), 5 (output contracts), and 6 (static verification rules 1-11):
- src/lockstep/taskgraph.py
- src/lockstep/contracts.py
- src/lockstep/cli.py
- src/lockstep/__init__.py

Hunt for REAL discrepancies only: a MUST not implemented, an exit code wrong or missing, a verification rule absent or weaker than specified, a model field diverging from the spec, defaults that differ. Check docs/spec/DEVIATIONS.md first — a logged deviation is not a finding unless the log misstates it. Ignore style, naming, and anything the amendments explicitly changed.

Report each discrepancy as a Finding object with EXACTLY these fields: severity (one of "blocker", "major", "minor", "nit"), category (string, e.g. "spec-mismatch"), file (repo-relative path), line (integer or null), claim (one sentence), evidence (quote the spec text AND the code that diverges), fix_hint (string, may be empty).

IMPORTANT: this is a fresh, independent review of the CURRENT working tree. Ignore the runs/ directory and any prior-attempt or earlier-audit artifacts you encounter; re-derive every finding from the files as they exist NOW, and verify every quoted line against current file content before reporting it.

Your result MUST be ONLY a JSON array of Finding objects — an empty array if the implementation is faithful. You cannot write files; print the JSON array as the final content of your response.
